description.value:
Land vehicles with a Heavy Chassis (no motorcycles). DV17 Basic Tech and 12 hours to fit. Hitch or unhitch a trailer as an Action; −2 to Drive Land Vehicle while towing. Trailers take vehicle upgrades like a Heavy Chassis vehicle, but don't share the tow vehicle's armor, glass or security. With an AV-4 Engine or Hover upgrade, both need one.

Cost / Moto: 1,000eb
Fits: All Land Vehicles except Bikes

Item Compendium (2070) • Vehicles & Upgrades
